The City of Bedford City Council gives
notice of a public hearings on Tues-
day, August 23, 2022 at 6:00 p.m. at
City Halli, Council Chamber, 2000 For-
est Ridge Drive, Building A, Bedford,
Texas:

Conduct a public hearing and consid-
er a rezoning request for 5 acres le-
gally described as Tracts 2D01 and 2D
of the Teeter Garret Survey Abstract
1537 from R-15,000 (single-family
homes on 15,000 square foot lots)
to R-7,500 (single-family homes on
7,500 square foot lots). The property is
generally located south side of Cheek
Sparger Road, approximately 500 feet
east of the Central Drive and Cheek
Sparger Road intersection, commoniy
known as 2416 Cheek Sparger Road.
(PZ-ZC-2022-50049)

Conduct a public hearing and con-
sider a rezoning request for 2.460
acres legally described as Lots 42 &
43 of the J.R. Murphy Addition from
Single-Family Detached R-15,000
to R-6,500 with minimum lot size of
6,500 square feet. The property is
generally located north of Bedford
Road, south of Harwood Road and to
the west of Murphy Drive, commoniy
known as 2511 Murphy Drive. (PZ-
PUD-2022-50048)

All interested citizens will be given the
opportunity to speak and be heard.
